verses.text: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

segments.text: The heavens declare the glory of God;
And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

verses.text: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.

segments.text: Day unto day uttereth speech,
And night unto night showeth knowledge.

verses.text: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.

segments.text: There is no speech nor language;
Their voice is not heard.

verses.text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

segments.text: Their line is gone out through all the earth,
And their words to the end of the world.
In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

segments.text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,
And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

verses.text: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

segments.text: His going forth is from the end of the heavens,
And his circuit unto the ends of it;
And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.text: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

segments.text: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul:
The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.text: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

segments.text: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart:
The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.text: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, and righteous altogether.

segments.text: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever:
The ordinances of Jehovah are true,
and
righteous altogether.

verses.text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

segments.text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold;
Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

verses.text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.

segments.text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned:
In keeping them there is great reward.

verses.text: Who can discern his errors? Clear thou me from hidden faults.

segments.text: Who can discern
his
errors?
Clear thou me from hidden
faults

verses.text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.

segments.text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous
sins
Let them not have dominion over me:
Then shall I be upright,
And I shall be clear from great transgression.

verses.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.

segments.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
Be acceptable in thy sight,
O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
